tools.name: get_current_cola
tools.description: Return the latest tracked 2027 Social Security COLA status, rate, CPI-W observations, timestamp, and primary source links.

tools.name: calculate_benefit_change
tools.description: Estimate the monthly and annual benefit change using COLA Insight's latest tracked rate. This is an educational estimate, not an SSA benefit determination.

tools.name: get_cola_history
tools.description: Return preserved forecast, formula-derived, and official COLA snapshots in reverse chronological order.

tools.name: get_cola_sources
tools.description: Return the government sources, methodology, data dictionary, and public datasets used by COLA Insight.
